A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BPB-GNN research, with readable text, equations, figures and appendices. The theoretical and experimental material can be matched despite extensive presentation changes and removal of v1's checklist.

before.justification: v1 reports original Hamiltonian Monte Carlo simulations, student-teacher experiments on CSBM graphs, and Cora prediction and branch analyses in Figures 1–8.

after.justification: v2 retains the original CSBM student-teacher simulations and Cora experimental results, including HMC samples, prediction performance and branch analyses.

M1.justification: The independent linear GCN branches, summed readout, Gaussian weight prior, squared-loss Bayesian regression and prediction procedure are retained. Expanded architecture and sampling explanations do not establish a changed method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same CSBM student-teacher task and binary node regression on Cora. No dataset, domain or distinct test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The GP/wide-width reference and student-teacher comparisons remain the same. No additional baseline model is evaluated; the added architectural citations provide background.

E3.justification: Appendix B retains the CSBM parameters, teacher width, temperatures, Cora 21%/79% split, class grouping and HMC width limits. New descriptions of label encoding and plot normalization document existing experiments without establishing a revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The width and regularization sweeps, branch-count comparisons, bias–variance analyses, branch-norm analyses and Cora kernel visualizations are retained. Expanded explanations and redrawn plots do not introduce a new supplementary analysis.

E5.justification: v1's checklist explicitly explains that error bars were omitted because estimating HMC errors was computationally expensive; v2 removes this disclosure. This is a limited reporting change: neither version supplies repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: The performance curves and HMC points in Figures 1–6 and 8 match. Figure 7 changes the kernel heatmaps' upper labeled colorbar values from approximately 0.3–0.35 to 1.0, alongside other display changes. The PDFs do not resolve whether kernel values or normalization changed, or only their visualization.

T1.justification: The underlying kernel-renormalization, predictor-statistics and equipartition mathematics are retained, including the variance-weighted order-parameter relation. v2's main-text saddle equation already appears in v1 Appendix A.1. The reorganized proof sketch retains the concentration assumption and does not supply a new proof of the conjecture.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same central claims: narrow-width branch specialization, competitive or better generalization in bias-limited settings, and branch norms reflecting properties of the data.

C2.justification: v2 explicitly emphasizes the conjectural concentration assumption and qualifies Cora as suggesting a potential narrow-width limit below feasible widths. Section 5 replaces language about verifying equipartition with consistency with student-teacher results and adds a ground-truth-teacher interpretation.

D1.justification: v2 newly identifies the HMC software as 'Numpyrho' and mentions GPU-cluster execution, explicitly states Cora's ±1 labels, and explains plot normalizations. Removing the checklist also removes v1's statement that code was not ready for release. No code-access location is added.

R1.justification: v2 adds supporting references to Neal, Betancourt, He et al., Kipf and Welling, and McCallum et al. The research positioning and comparison with Cong et al. remain substantially unchanged; the additional Chen bibliography entry duplicates an already cited work.

P1.justification: v2 substantially expands the exposition and captions, reorganizes Section 4.1 into an explicit conjecture and proof sketch, clarifies experimental descriptions, and adds a structured notation glossary before the appendix derivations. It also removes the NeurIPS checklist while retaining the main scientific section sequence.

P2.justification: The figures are broadly reformatted and relabeled, captions expanded, notation tables added, and page layout revised. Figure 7 changes from one row to a labeled 2×4 grid. Some changes introduce errors: Figure 3 labels variance axes 'Squared Bias' and repeats 'Branch 0' over the branch-1 bias panel.

improvement.justification: The expanded captions and notation glossary make the retained theory and HMC comparisons easier to assess, while the conjecture and Cora qualifications improve interpretive caution. These clarity gains are partly offset by new Figure 3 labeling errors and lost checklist disclosures. The revision provides a limited overall improvement without substantially stronger scientific evidence.
